what_works: Branding system built around a custom icon grid representing taste/smell variables — every product (or in our case, every service) gets a small diagrammed glyph, all rendered in matching stroke weight. Transplants beautifully for an HVAC tech or plumber who wants services to feel measured/diagnosed, not bulleted.
what_does_not_translate: The silver metallic packaging substrate is offline brand material, not web — translate the icon-system idea to inline SVGs in one accent color.
type_observations: Single ultra-clean grotesk in two weights; the icon stroke weight matches the type stroke weight for cohesion.
